## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request is focused on one concern.
- [ ] I preserved unrelated changes and reused existing components.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] Formatting, analysis, and tests pass.
- [ ] I ran the affected platform build or explained why it was skipped.
- [ ] I tested loading, empty, success, error, and offline states where relevant.
- [ ] I added no credentials, tokens, student data, generated output, or signing files.
- [ ] Sensitive values remain in secure storage and persistence errors remain explicit.
- [ ] New dependencies are necessary and compatible with GPL-3.0.
- [ ] Branding changes follow TRADEMARKS.md and do not imply BRAC University endorsement.
- [ ] User-facing or contributor documentation is updated when behavior changed.
